ExplorerBlurMica — bundled third-party component
================================================

ExplorerBlurMica.dll is the official release binary of
https://github.com/Maplespe/ExplorerBlurMica (version 2.1.0, x64),
by Maplespe. SHA-256:
36b44444fc8ae1c4fdc3a80cdc6b0c0a04cc843984189c17dadf964bcaa9f052

It is licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License v3
(see COPYING.LESSER). CoreDesk loads it as a shell extension
(COM in-process server) at runtime; it is not linked or modified.
You may replace this file with any compatible build of
ExplorerBlurMica — CoreDesk deploys and registers whatever is at
this path (or already deployed to the residents directory).
